officialApp.name: Nothing X
officialApp.appVersionObserved: 2.4.9 (SoundGuys review, Aug 2024, firmware 1.0.5.49); current Play listing updated 2026-11-03
officialApp.notes: CMF Buds use the Nothing X app, not a separate CMF app.

battery.chargingIndicators: Case LED; numeric L/C/R levels in Nothing X.
battery.notes: DIRECT EVIDENCE: the Nothing X home screen for CMF Buds (1st gen) shows three separate readings, 100% L / 80% C / 100% R, in SoundGuys' review screenshot taken with Nothing X 2.4.9 and firmware 1.0.5.49. Buds are split L/R and the case is a separate tile. The case reading requires the case to be open; Nothing's support article says the app must be active and the case open. This model is therefore NOT a combined-battery device in the official app. If OmniBuds shows one combined bud percentage for CMF Buds 1, that is an OmniBuds parsing/rendering defect, not the official behaviour.

anc.notes: 42 dB hybrid ANC; no adaptive or personalised ANC.

controls.notes: Touch area at the top of the stem. No single tap.

audio.notes: Dirac-tuned; 3-band custom EQ; no spatial audio.
